text:
lara: deploy-bot paused promotion for tag=release-2026.06.01 — build step 'fetch-private-deps' failed on canary builders.

deploy-bot: "promotion paused for tag=release-2026.06.01, reason=ci/fetch-private-deps x3 failures"

ci-system: logs show 401 when pip tries to pull private wheels from internal PyPI mirror: `ERROR HTTP 401 Unauthorized "GET /packages/foo-1.2.3.whl"`

marc: we rotated the pypi service token ~45m ago for security. Some runners didn't pick up the new token due to credential-volumes restart lag.

sre-ana: I can see varying token versions across runner pool nodes; some still use old creds (401) while others succeed. This causes intermittent artifact build gaps.

release-mgr: change window closes in 50 minutes. Options: (A) pin to previous prod image release-2026.05.25; (B) fix credential rollout and re-run canaries (may take ~25-40m); (C) extend window.

lara: prefer pin to avoid missing window. We'll schedule a rerun after creds fully rolled out.

pip-ops-bot: recommendation: enforce token rollout via `rollout-check` and fail promote if any runner reports auth mismatch.

marc: immediate mitigation: trigger credential-volume restart on 20% of runners to accelerate rollout, then rerun canaries serialized. But still slower than pin.

release-mgr: decision: pin to release-2026.05.25 to meet the window. Opening ENG-4011 for follow-up (owner: marc). Manual promote now.

deploy-bot: running `promote --image=release-2026.05.25 --reason="ci-private-pypi-auth-rotation"`

deploy-bot: Promotion complete. Production now points to release-2026.05.25. :white_check_mark:

lara: ENG-4011 created, assigned to marc. Follow-up: complete token rollout, add pre-promote credential-check, rerun canaries tomorrow 08:30 UTC with CI_SERIAL_NAMESPACE=true. Close after ENG-4011 has initial triage. :lock:
